title: Cancel terminal lift-up on the entire streamwise-independent sector
statement: Let phi rise linearly on[0,1/4], equal1 on[1/4,3/4], fall linearly to0 at1, and vanish elsewhere. Set g(z)=sum_(r=0)^4(-1)^r binom(4,r)phi(z-r),alpha(t)=A g(t/T). Fourth finite differences imply integral_0^5 z^q g(z)dz=0 for q=0,1,2,3; g endpoints zero, L1<=12,Linf<=6. On k_i=0 the transverse components follow heat and the exact streamwise lift-up Fourier coefficient is (kappa AT/2)exp[-5beta((m+sigma)^2+l^2)]integral g(z)exp[beta(2sigma m+1)z]dz, beta=nu kappa^2 T. Fourth-order Taylor cancellation and Gaussian maximization yield ||S_alpha(5T)-exp(5nu T Delta)||_(2->2,k_i=0)<=2^256 |A|T beta^2 for0<beta<=1. Rational A=2^(8n),T=2^(-3n) gives bound<=2^(267-n) for nu<=1 and sufficiently large n. This is uniform on the ENTIRE infinite-dimensional neutral sector; terminal cancellation does not remove intermediate transient growth.
